howPage.title: How to Order
howPage.intro: Shopping at TechRevive is assisted by our team on WhatsApp. There is no cart or upfront payment: you pay only after the unit is confirmed ready.

steps.d: Browse the catalog and use spec, brand and feature filters to match your needs.
Click Order Now, then enter your name, WhatsApp number and area. WhatsApp opens with a prefilled message.
Our team confirms the unit's QC result, the final price and the delivery schedule. The price is locked for 24 hours.

steps.t: Pay once the unit is ready

faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.intro: Quick answers to the most common questions. Can't find yours? Contact us on WhatsApp.
faqPage.stillAskDesc: Our team replies within 15 minutes during business hours.

items.a: Yes. Every unit has a full 1-month warranty from delivery. If something goes wrong, our team can pick up the unit and deliver it back. After the warranty ends, servicing is still available for a fee, and we tell you the cost before any work starts. You can file a claim directly on the Track Order page with your order code and WhatsApp number.
Pick a product and click Order Now. Enter your name, WhatsApp number and delivery area. You will be taken to WhatsApp with a prefilled message and our team continues the confirmation.

These units are going through, or about to go through, our quality check before they are ready to ship. 'Available' means the unit has passed QC and is ready. We never write 'Available' until it is certain.

items.q: How long is the price locked?
items.a: Once we send the final price it is locked for 24 hours. After that the quote expires and the price may change.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Bank transfer, virtual account and QRIS. Payment is requested only after the unit is confirmed ready and you accept the quote.

items.q: How does delivery work and what does it cost?
items.a: We serve Jabodetabek. Items are hand-delivered by our team or sent by courier as agreed. The fee and estimate are shared at confirmation.

items.q: What do Grade A, B and C mean?
items.a: Grade A: mint. Grade B: normal wear with light scratches. Grade C: visible cosmetic flaws but works normally. Battery health is listed where applicable.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Open the Track Order page and enter your inquiry code (starting with TR-) and the WhatsApp number you used to order.
Your name and WhatsApp number are used only to process your request and are never shared with third parties.

aboutPage.title: About TechRevive
aboutPage.intro: A direct supplier of quality laptops, smartphones and gadgets, from new to refurbished, with honest information and a simple ordering process.
story: TechRevive makes upgrading your devices easy and worry-free. We offer curated laptops, smartphones and gadgets for studying, working and creating, from new units to refurbished ones to fit your needs and budget.
As a direct supplier, every unit passes our Check QC before it reaches you. You get a clear grade, real photos of the actual unit and transparent pricing, with no surprises.
aboutPage.mission: Make quality devices affordable and easy to choose, with honest information and dependable service.
aboutPage.vision: To be the first place people trust for upgrading their tech in Greater Jakarta.

values.d: Every unit gets an A/B/C grade based on its real condition, with photos of the actual unit.
Our team checks each unit before it ships, including core functions and battery health where applicable.
Every item has a full 1-month warranty. After it ends, service is still available for a fee.
Clear prices, and quotes stay locked for their validity period, with no hidden fees.

process.d: Browse the catalog with spec filters, then send an inquiry.
Our team replies on WhatsApp, checks the unit and sends a quote.
After payment the unit goes through Check QC and is packed.
Delivered by our team or by courier. Follow it on Track Order.

aboutPage.ctaDesc: Browse the catalog or tell us what you need, and we will reply quickly.

founder.title: Behind TechRevive
bio: Muhammad Fajri Ramadhan founded TechRevive on a simple belief: quality second-hand devices deserve to be sold honestly. Every unit is checked, graded as it really is and covered by a warranty, so buyers in Jabodetabek can choose with confidence.
He keeps inspection standards and after-sales care a priority, from the first unit to the next customer.
